verdict.rationale: Bolt documents a first-party Figma integration that loads Figma designs and generates sites and UIs from them. A design system agent recreates frames using your real design system components, and Google Stitch import plus file uploads cover other existing designs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Figma import fidelity.

support.subject: As a designer, I can import a Figma file or existing design and have the builder implement it

citations.quote: Using Bolt's Figma integration, you can quickly load Figma designs into Bolt, and generate sites and UIs based on the designs.
Bolt's design system agent processes the frame and recreates it using your real design system components.
Anyone can start from a blank prompt, upload files to build with, or import designs from Figma or Google Stitch.
Export your Google Stitch designs to Bolt and build them into a fully functional app.
